jumping_rationale: The approved source strip contains the intended vertical jump arc. Per-frame component fitting cancels that motion, so stable-slots is required to preserve takeoff, apex, and landing while keeping a shared 192x208 viewport.
failed_rationale: The low side-lying poses are wider than upright poses and their chroma-edge components approach neighboring slots. Stable-slots preserves the authored elbow-brace and buckle timing without merging or independently rescaling poses.
